company.name: ROVR
company.shortDescription: Whether you're looking for friendship or romance, ROVR is the only app you'll need to find what you desire.
company.description:
ROVR is an iOS and Android mobile application that helps its users connect with new people and create lasting memories. It is categorized under three sections; casual, serious, and friends. Its users can control what sections of the app their profile appears in, so they know the intentions of the people they meet through the application. It helps spark the conversation once its users have matched with a potential date or connected with a new acquaintance.

ROVR is a U.S.-based company that was founded in 2015 by Michael Young.
